rulings.reason: The act reads the full catalogue and immediately promises another paged reading with no actor who lacks the catalogue or other need; its pagination promise also stops after one remaining model in the life.
rulings.requiredFix: Remove the immediate pagination promise from act 1. Keep LibreChat reading the complete catalogue with prices; the subsequent conversation and follow-up remain its reason for connecting.

doubts.doubt: The old-note key check after the CLI already saved its OAuth key is unusual but can represent a person manually selecting an obsolete credential; the shown replacement supplies a cause, so it is not a ruling.
The prose does not claim the stub edits files. Preserve the explicit limitation that generated prose quality and actual file changes are not inferred from stub output.

findings: Read the frame and all four acts against every bar item. Actors use separate captured bearer keys with inference/own-key grants. Catalogue is public. Dates and ten-minute expiry fit the World clock. Tool calls have application-supplied results. No unsupported management act is promised.
